summary: Registration thunk in the vehicle/collision subsystem. Reads the stored null-subroutine address from global 0x0044CC00 and returns the result of passing that address through BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E). The nullsub global has no static writers, so its value is installed elsewhere at runtime; this function is a minimal wrapper that surfaces a registered callback slot through the shared boolean-to-int conversion helper.

operations.description: Read global nullsub_46 (0x0044CC00), a stored null-subroutine function address, to form the single argument.
Call BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) with the nullsub address cast to int as its argument.
Return the integer produced by BooleanToIntConversion directly.

unresolved: The nullsub global (0x0044CC00) has no static writers; its callback address is installed by runtime registration code not visible in this function.
Why a stored callback address is routed through BooleanToIntConversion (a boolean-to-int helper) rather than invoked directly is not determinable here.
